profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Affirm | Service mesh and east-west traffic infrastructure | Envoy · xDS · Kubernetes · Go · Python · Kotlin
profile.summary: I am a computer science major at San Jose State University looking for a full-time software engineering position, and I am skilled in Python, Java, and Node.js, but I am confident in my ability to learn any other language. Ever since I was young, I loved to code and work with electronics. Coding anything from small projects that solves a repetitive task to large scale applications gives off such a satisfying feeling of a working product that does what I want it to do. Throughout my years at San Jose State, I have developed multiple projects on my own and in a team environment. I have created mobile applications such as a basic Yelp and Instagram clone utilizing APIs and databases. I have worked on multiple projects to help the community with the latest one being a fitness inventory tracker for anyone looking to build a home gym during the COVID-19 pandemic when equipment was always sold out. This stock tracker is now used daily by over 10,000 people to facilitate an estimated over $1M in sales. I am also vice president of the Computer Science club at SJSU and am always helping to create and facilitate hackathons, mock interviews, and other events to help students advance their career readiness. I am confident I will make a positive impact with my team-oriented mindset and ability to write clean, reusable code with documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Used React, PHP, MySQL to design, develop, and test new platform features
- Won best overall hack day project for implementing a favorites feature that is currently in production
- Built RESTful APIS using PHP
- Created a Microsoft Teams integration in Node.js and PHP for GoLinks to be used by all customers and as a key selling point to bring new customers to the product
- Followed the agile software development cycle
- Analyzed user requirements and converted requirements to design documents via SPIKEs and PRDs
- Clearly and regularly communicated with team and management
- Worked closely with product and design team on scope of future projects
- Identified and fixed key platform bugs to ensure a better user experience for customers

positions.title: Good Tech Scholars Program Participant
positions.description:
Participated in an IBM summer program which entailed self-paced badging courses, ideation workshops, design thinking workshops, and IBM Cloud workshops, followed by a hackathon.

- Won second place out of over 15 teams in the program overall
- Constructed a website within a team of five and deployed it online using IBM Cloud Foundry
- Used HTML, CSS, Node.js, Express, and Python alongside cloud computing services such as Cloudant to store our databases
- Directly worked on creating the entire backend and linking the UI to our database
- Completed badging courses on Professional Skills, Data Science, and Cloud via the Open P-TECH and Cognitive Class websites
- Built solutions to data-related challenges around providing quality education for all

projects.title: Fitness Inventory Tracker
projects.description: I used Python to create an automated system to alert users within seconds of home gym equipment being stocked. It is deployed on Google Cloud and scaled for daily use of 10,000+ concurrent users tracking 150+ items. I utilized Reddit and Discord APIs for notifications. It is estimated to have facilitated close to $1M+ in transactions to Rogue and other various fitness sites.

projects.title: Walnut - Donation Web App
projects.description: The process of donating to charities or social programs should aim to be as easy and accessible as possible, so that more people can get involved to create a bigger impact. Walnut was inspired by Acorns investing and uses roundups to automate the donation process. We used Javascript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, Express, and Python to build a mockup IBM Cloud based financial app as a donation tool for charities in an IBM GTSP challenge and won second place. It is deployed at: https://walnut-app.mybluemix.net/
